tooltip.interceptors.gaming_van: White high-roof camper with a gaming PC in the back. Fast, comfy, not armored.
tooltip.interceptors.dominator_1: Reed Timmer's first armored Tahoe. Push bar, weather mast, ground spikes.
tooltip.interceptors.dominator_2: Longer armored Yukon XL. Hydraulic side skirts drop to the road with the anchors.
tooltip.interceptors.dominator_3: The big angular armored truck. Toughest of the Dominators: skirts plus three pairs of spikes.
tooltip.interceptors.tiv_1: The first Tornado Intercept Vehicle. Slow as a tank, built like one. Louvered armor glass.
tooltip.interceptors.doppler_on_wheels: A radar truck with a spinning dish. Light armor, but its screens see storms much farther away.
